pending.wisdom: There are moments when tribulations occur in our lives, and we cannot avoid them. But they are there for some reason … Only when we have overcome them do we understand why they were there.
pending.author: Paulo Coelho

pending.wisdom: It always helps to have people we love beside us when we have to do difficult things in life.
pending.author: Fred Rogers

pending.wisdom: There is something you must remember. You are braver than you believe, stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think. But the most important thing is, even if we’re apart, I’ll always be with you.
pending.author: Christopher Robin
